mappings.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
mappings.summary: Routes the released OWASP LLM risks to AITBM tests and evidence without assigning generic risk scores.

mappings.title: OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations
mappings.summary: Maps agentic threats and the companion Top 10 to AITBM containment, robustness, privacy, and operational-risk evidence.

mappings.title: OWASP AISVS
mappings.summary: Shows how AISVS control-verification results can supply evidence for AITBM's 23 measured sub-metrics.

mappings.title: MITRE ATLAS
mappings.summary: Uses released ATLAS tactics and techniques to select AITBM tests while keeping system scoring deployment-specific.

mappings.title: AIUC-1
mappings.summary: Relates AIUC-1 requirements to AITBM evidence, assurance, and operational-risk inputs without treating certification as a score.

mappings.title: AIDEFEND
mappings.summary: Connects defensive techniques to the AITBM sub-metrics they may evidence when deployed effectiveness is measured.

mappings.title: NIST AI RMF
mappings.summary: Maps GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE activities to AITBM assessment evidence and decision outputs.

mappings.title: ISO/IEC 42001 and 42005
mappings.summary: Relates management-system and impact-assessment evidence to AITBM scoring, governance, and assurance inputs.

mappings.title: EU AI Act
mappings.summary: Maps relevant legal obligations to evidence routes while making clear that AITBM is not a legal-compliance determination.

mappings.title: CSA AI Security
mappings.summary: Connects CSA MAESTRO and AICM controls to AITBM test selection and deployment evidence.

mappings.title: NIST Cyber AI Profile (IR 8596)
mappings.summary: Relates the Cyber AI Profile's outcomes to AITBM's measured properties, context, and evidence confidence.

mappings.title: OWASP AIMA
mappings.summary: Shows how maturity practices can support AITBM evidence without converting maturity levels directly into ERS.

mappings.title: COMPASS
mappings.summary: Maps COMPASS practices to AITBM threat prioritization, evidence collection, and scoring inputs.

mappings.title: MITRE D3FEND
mappings.summary: Uses defensive countermeasures to organize evidence routes while AITBM tests determine the actual score.

mappings.title: CVSS
mappings.summary: Explains where CVSS complements AITBM and why AI system risk still requires multidimensional and confidence-aware assessment.

mappings.title: GPAI Code of Practice
mappings.summary: Relates transparency, safety, security, and copyright commitments to AITBM evidence and assessment boundaries.
